semantics: Any newly created or modified JSON that writes a terminal/frozen scientific_state must carry a PASS reconstruction certificate bound to exact capsule and registry roots with R00-R19 all pass. Untouched legacy evidence is grandfathered; storage failure never rewrites scientific_state.
branch_protection_limitation: main is not repository-protected; therefore a physically direct noncompliant push may land, but it is scientifically non-authoritative and must not be promoted by durable authority pointers. This limitation remains a governance/infrastructure consideration, not a false PASS claim.
